data.narrative:
UFORCE, a Seed-stage defense and security company, carries a current post-money valuation of $1.0B on $50M raised. The valuation assessment draws from a peer set of 13 same-sector companies ranging from early private to late-stage and public, including Chaos Industries ($4.5B Series D), Skydio ($4.4B Series F), Dream Security ($3.0B Series B), True Anomaly ($2.2B SPAC), and Onebrief ($2.1B Series D), alongside two public comps (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). The broader peer universe spans eight private and two public entities in Defense & Security.

Two valuation methods triangulate the range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement to the $1.0B base, implying $2.5B. Peer-median anchoring across the 13-company cohort yields $1.2B, with the comp set spanning $300M to $4.5B. The gap between methods reflects valuation dispersion within the frontier-defense sector and stage heterogeneity in comparable companies.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.1B (low) to $2.9B (high), with a median of $1.9B. Key uncertainties include product maturation pace, customer acquisition trajectory in a regulated defense market, and competitive positioning relative to better-funded Series B–D peers. The wide peer range ($300M–$4.5B) underscores sector volatility and heterogeneous risk profiles.
